name: tooluniverse
description: ToolUniverse: an ecosystem for democratizing AI scientists with 2,500+ scientific tools.
long_description: ToolUniverse is an ecosystem for creating AI scientist systems from any large language model (LLM). It standardizes how LLMs interact with tools, integrating thousands of machine learning models, datasets, APIs, and scientific packages for data analysis, knowledge retrieval, and experimental design. This bundle exposes ToolUniverse capability via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), enabling AI assistants to perform complex scientific tasks.

tooluniverse_env_file.title: API key file (.env)
tooluniverse_env_file.description: Optional path to a .env file holding any of ToolUniverse's API keys. Every key the catalogue knows about can be set this way; the fields below are shortcuts for the most used ones. Leave empty to use ~/.tooluniverse/.env if you have one.

boltz_api_key.title: Boltz API key
boltz_api_key.description: Unlocks 72 structure-prediction, binding and ADME tools. Leave empty to skip them.

nvidia_api_key.title: NVIDIA API key
nvidia_api_key.description: Unlocks 17 hosted NVIDIA model tools. Leave empty to skip them.

alpha_genome_api_key.title: AlphaGenome API key
alpha_genome_api_key.description: Unlocks 10 AlphaGenome variant-effect tools. Leave empty to skip them.

esm_api_key.title: ESM API key
esm_api_key.description: Unlocks 10 ESM protein-language-model tools. Leave empty to skip them.

ncbi_api_key.title: NCBI API key
ncbi_api_key.description: Optional. Raises NCBI rate limits for 34 tools that work without it.

fda_api_key.title: openFDA API key
fda_api_key.description: Optional. Raises openFDA rate limits for 18 tools that work without it.
